card.name: Commas in lists of CYP3A inhibitor drugs
card.fires_on: Commas (and a colon) right after a drug name in lists of strong CYP3A inhibitors, such as clarithromycin, itraconazole, ketoconazole, nefazodone and nelfinavir.

modes.label: Comma between listed drugs
modes.description: The comma that follows one azole, macrolide or protease inhibitor name inside a list of interacting drugs.
modes.example: , atazanavir, clarithromycin, indinavir, itraconazole, ketoconazole, nefazodone<<,>> nelfinavir, riton

modes.label: Colon after drug class
modes.description: The colon after a class heading such as Antibiotics that introduces a list of inhibitor drugs.
modes.example: ALKINDI SPRINKLE dose. Examples: Anti-fungals: itraconazole, posaconazole, voriconazole Antibiotics<<:>> erythromycin and clarithrom

card.plain: It marks the spot in a drug-interaction list where the next drug name in the series is about to come.
